model: AI lab selling intelligence by the token (consumption 80%, subscriptions 20%, 48% via cloud marketplaces). Buys compute under minimum cloud commitments (Google ~$114.5B to 2033, Amazon $110B to 2036, Microsoft $44.9B to 2033) and leases through landlords and neoclouds; $265.6B of minimum purchases and $321.4B of uncommenced leases at June 2026 against $11.6B of Q2 revenue. Rents rather than owns compute (PP&E $1.2B). Funded by $131.7B of cash after the Series H, a $15B revolver and $77B of conditional supplier notes (Broadcom $42B at 9-13% PIK, Google $20B, Amazon $15B). Watch: revenue per compute dollar (Q2 2026 $2.08), commitments vs trailing revenue, supplier-note draws, customer concentration, compute allocated to research vs serving. Hyperscaler/buyer mode applies: this is the credit behind most of the guide's financings.
